collection.title: Subaru Justy 1984 to 1995 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Subaru Justy 1984 to 1995 model requires a 18" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 17" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade, we also have rear blade for this Justy, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
